description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the MembershipAPI in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing API endpoints related to Membership entities such as retrieving all memberships, retrieving a specific membership, creating, updating, and deleting memberships.

classes.name: MembershipAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests various API endpoints of the MembershipAPI for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes setup for test data and multiple test methods utilizing data providers to verify behavior for get all, get one, create, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by truncating specific database tables and populating fixture data from the specified YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' endpoint of the MembershipAPI with different test cases provided by the data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'getAll' API method, reading scenarios from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' endpoint of the MembershipAPI with scenarios from the data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'getOne' API method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the 'create' endpoint of the MembershipAPI using multiple test scenarios.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'create' API operation.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the 'update' endpoint of the MembershipAPI with various test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'update' API method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the 'delete' endpoint of the MembershipAPI with different scenarios.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'delete' API operation.
